prompt: Which sentence says: Once you have decided, do not change it?
options: 一旦你决定了，就不要改变。
一旦你决定了，不要就改变。
zh: 一旦你决定了，就不要改变。
en: Once you have decided, do not change it.
Once it gets dark, we will go home.
wrong: 如果一旦天黑，我们就回家。
explain: 一旦 already means once or if; do not add 如果.

zh: 他很努力，从而取得了好成绩。
en: He worked hard and so achieved good results.

prompt: Which sentence says: Tomorrow we will either take the train or take a plane?
options: 明天我们或是坐火车，或是坐飞机。
明天我们或是坐火车，还是坐飞机。
zh: 明天我们或是坐火车，或是坐飞机。
en: Tomorrow we will either take the train or take a plane.
explain: 或是 pairs with 或是.

zh: 明天他或是来，或是打电话。
en: Tomorrow he will either come or call.
explain: 或是 + choice, 或是 + choice.

en: Whether one goes or not, it is all the same.

prompt: Which sentence says: Whether it is rice or noodles, I like them both?
options: 吃米饭也好，吃面条也好，我都喜欢。
吃米饭也好，吃面条好，我都喜欢。
zh: 吃米饭也好，吃面条也好，我都喜欢。
en: Whether it is rice or noodles, I like them both.
explain: Each part ends with 也好.

zh: 坐车也好，走路也好，我都行。
en: Whether by bus or on foot, I am fine with either.
Counting me, there are five people in all.

zh: 我们买了书、笔以及本子。
en: We bought books, pens and notebooks.
wrong: 我们买了书、笔以及和本子。
explain: 以及 already joins the last item.

en: Without effort, there is no success.

prompt: Which sentence says: Without friends, there is no happiness?
options: 没有朋友，就没有快乐。
没有朋友，就有快乐。
en: Without friends, there is no happiness.
explain: The second part is also 没有.

en: Without air, there is no life.
wrong: 没有空气，就不没有生命。

prompt: Which sentence says: He leaves early so as to catch the train?
options: 他早点出门，以便赶上火车。
他早点出门，便以赶上火车。
zh: 他早点出门，以便赶上火车。
en: He leaves early so as to catch the train.
We take the school as the centre.
He takes getting into university as his goal.
wrong: 他以考上大学为是目标。
explain: 以 … 为 … has no 是.

zh: 我给他钱，他反而生气了。
en: I gave him money, but he got angry instead.

prompt: Which sentence says: The weather did not get better; instead it got colder?
options: 天气不但没好，反而更冷了。
天气不但没好，更冷反而了。
zh: 天气不但没好，反而更冷了。
en: The weather did not get better; instead it got colder.
explain: 反而 comes before 更冷.

en: Hurry up, otherwise it will be late.

zh: 多穿一点衣服，不然容易感冒。
en: Wear more clothes, otherwise it is easy to catch a cold.
wrong: 多穿一点衣服，不然要是容易感冒。

en: He is still young after all.
explain: 毕竟 goes before the verb or adjective.

prompt: Which sentence says: A child is a child after all?
options: 孩子毕竟是孩子。
孩子是毕竟孩子。
en: A child is a child after all.
He is only a student after all.

zh: 我想他会来，他果然来了。
en: I thought he would come, and sure enough he came.

prompt: Which sentence says: The weather forecast said rain, and sure enough it rained?
options: 天气预报说有雨，果然下雨了。
天气预报说有雨，下雨果然了。
zh: 天气预报说有雨，果然下雨了。
en: The weather forecast said rain, and sure enough it rained.
explain: 果然 comes before the verb.

en: This restaurant is indeed very tasty.
wrong: 这家饭店果然是很好吃。

en: Surprisingly, he does not know me.
He seems very tired.

prompt: Which sentence says: It seems he did not hear?
options: 他仿佛没听见。
他没仿佛听见。
en: It seems he did not hear.
He seems not very happy.
Seen from here, the mountain is very high.

zh: 从我的经验来看，这个办法不错。
en: From my experience, this method is good.
wrong: 从我的经验来看了，这个办法不错。

en: Take him, for example: he loves sport.

prompt: Which sentence says: Take study, for example: he is better than me?
options: 拿学习来说，他比我好。
拿学习说来，他比我好。
en: Take study, for example: he is better than me.
Take the north, for example: it is cold there.
wrong: 拿北边来说，那里是很冷。

en: In his view, this is easy.

prompt: Which sentence says: In my view, he is right?
options: 在我看来，他是对的。
在看来我，他是对的。
en: In my view, he is right.
In short, this matter is important.

prompt: Which sentence says: Up to now, we have bought three books?
options: 到现在为止，我们已经买了三本书。
从现在为止，我们已经买了三本书。
zh: 到现在为止，我们已经买了三本书。
en: Up to now, we have bought three books.

zh: 到五点为止，我都在学校。
en: Until five o'clock, I will be at school.
wrong: 到五点为止了，我都在学校。
